summary: P1 meets its outcome: in-cluster interfaces for every placed Service and pooler, non-init Association links on every interface, and published-set resolution filtered like the render's own. Confirmed by a real ArgoCDDeploy render (arch-validate green) and mutation runs. Two advisory findings.

findings.summary: A Service's second host annotation (dns hostname beside server-name) gets no interface, so that host resolves in one render but not across renders; latent, no prd Service sets both
Published-lookup order (in-cluster form before host) and serving_at's instance filter survive mutation; no test pins them
